article.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
article.summary: Threat actors are attempting to exploit a recently disclosed security flaw impacting OpenSSH that can enable sign-ins to accounts that have no password set, according to Previdian. article.title: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It
article.summary: A fix for CVE-2026-83844, a remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint, is now in the Microsoft Store. Paint gets this fix only through a Store update, not through Windows updates. article.title: Certificate authority DigiCert reports data breach involving business customer info
article.summary: DigiCert explained that over the summer, an internal business system was "externally accessible when that was not intended," and someone had created an unauthorized account.

items.relevance_reason: Nhà cung cấp chứng thư số DigiCert bị xâm nhập hệ thống nội bộ dẫn đến rò rỉ dữ liệu thông tin khách hàng doanh nghiệp.

article.title: Japan Announces Emergency Cybersecurity Package Following a Wave of Attacks
